target.description: Research, compare and evaluate the next-generation Project Cockpit through browser-rendered experiments, preserve full decision history and exact implementation provenance, perform source-faithful holistic reintegration under deterministic gates, and evaluate unresolved whole-product interaction/presentation on the complete integrated Cockpit.

known_exposures: Specification 008 and Foundation 021 establish the promoted Cockpit architecture and professional product direction.
Accepted Phase-C mechanisms are bound to exact implementation provenance through the 23-entry manifest and remain protected by deterministic browser gates.
Quiet Graphite, Boxes/Text, A6 and Conversation coexistence remain the held Conversation direction.
The first holistic integration was rejected; Research 088 identified manual reimplementation from summaries as the fidelity failure mode.
Checkpoint 251 established source-faithful holistic reintegration as the protected whole-product substrate.
Research 092 and Research 093 preserve earlier direct-manipulation and architectural 3D rail candidates as historical evidence.
Research 094 tested a permanent resting angled rail and that treatment was later rejected for the current rail direction.
Checkpoint 255 flattened the current right rail and replaced the static Deep Dive compass with a live Project-Grid-derived topology instrument.
The project owner reported that the Checkpoint 255 Conversation row-gap correction still did not create visible spacing after pulling the latest branch.
Research 096 identified the layout-level blind spot: scaled/transformed canonical WorkUnits can visually consume nominal grid-row gaps.
Checkpoint 256 therefore combines a 16px list row gap with 6px top/bottom real WorkUnit-row padding and validates actual rendered node-surface separation at both 1600px and 760px widths.
The project owner requested Fullscreen restored to the current flat rail and requested Expand selected WorkUnit and Hide project HUD removed from that rail candidate.
The project owner explicitly confirmed that current-process Focus is working correctly and instructed that Focus be left unchanged.
The project owner then requested that the current Checkpoint 256 Cockpit be available on the normal no-query link rather than through historical ?edge=angled plumbing.

Checkpoint 257 makes the plain cockpit-reintegration.html route canonical, isolates explicit edge/rail historical study routes, and uses ?edge=none only as an internal earlier-shell regression substrate.
